verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pipedream lets you select an app-specific MCP server via an app slug and mentions general security/observability via 'Conduit', but there is no documentation of allowlisting specific servers/tools or per-tool access control that a platform engineer could configure to restrict what an agent may call. Missing for 10: explicit allowlist/denylist configuration, per-tool permission scoping, and admin-facing gateway controls documentation.
